en: Urban skyline view of a dense city with many mid- and high‑rise apartment and office buildings in hazy light. A curving river or canal runs through the foreground with embankments on both sides. The architecture is mostly modern concrete towers, with one distinctive white mid‑rise building featuring rounded corners and a small tower on its roof. The scene looks somewhat smoggy, suggesting a large industrial or commercial Asian metropolis. No visible text appears on the image.
